Values marked never-copied-stub-value test that secrets, tokens and passwords are never copied. Quota allowances mirror the live shape: no metadata.id, no spec.limit, usage omitted when not used. Tenant-level reads answer (tenant viewer + security-auditor granted 2026-10-11): no reservations, capacity advice without metadata.id, one project in the tenant that is not configured. Disk sizes: pvc-3f1c0e5a-tsdb is sized in spec.sizeBytes only (a CSI disk) and pvc-5d0b7e21-scratch has no size, so the live run-rate names it unpriced. Project allowance caps (with metadata.id, 2026-10-11 eu-west2 incident shape): sandbox vpc.allocation.count 13 under a tenant limit of 1000 and compute.instance.count 22 over a tenant limit of 12; staging compute.gpucluster.count with no limit (a cap of 0) under a tenant limit of 5.
